instruction: I prefer composing emails in HTML format with rich text formatting. Could you help me configure Thunderbird to always compose messages in HTML format instead of plain text?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling HTML composition mode by setting mail.identity.id1.compose_html to true. This preference controls whether new messages are composed in HTML format (with rich text formatting) or plain text format.
metadata.verification: The preference mail.identity.id1.compose_html is a standard Thunderbird setting. Setting it to true enables HTML composition mode for the primary identity.
